note: From FPL event/{gw}/live/ via the pipeline. Club figures (shots, shots on target) from football-data.co.uk E0.

missing.shot_map: Present. Shot coordinates for this gameweek come from ESPN. They carry no expected-goals value; per-shot xG exists only in bsd_shots.json (2025/26).
missing.big_chances: Not counted here. BSD's own per-player field is always null, so big chances are DERIVED from shots with xG >= 0.18 in bsd_players.json — a fitted proxy, not an Opta count, and only for 2025/26.
missing.woodwork: Present. ESPN reports it as its own shot outcome, and BSD does too.
missing.avg_position: Not available as a heatmap. BSD gives one average point per player per match, not a density grid, and no source carries touch-level positions.
missing.touches_in_box: Not available. Needs Opta event data (FBref), which answers 403.
